summary.headline: Table of Contents
summary.text: Table of contents for the catalogue of Venetian astrological codices, followed by appendices and excerpts from codices Marc. CCCXIII, CCCXIV, and CCCXXIV. Entries include Heliodorus, Dorotheus of Sidon, Vettius Valens, Achmet the Persian, Maseres, Muhamat the Balkhian, Aleim son of Isaac, and Eleutherius the Zebelenian, with astrological topics such as star configurations, inceptions, and life-time judgments.
